title: Google Ads for Moving Companies (7 Step Strategy)

facts.fact: The page states that Google Ads is a 'pay-per-click' advertising suite, so the advertiser only pays when someone clicks the ad.
facts.quote: Because Google Ads are 'pay-per-click' ads, you only pay when someone clicks on your Google Ads to visit your website or book your services.

facts.fact: The page lists the Google network components covered by Google Ads as Google Search, Maps, YouTube, Display, and Discovery.
facts.quote: encompassing the whole Google network, including Google Search, Maps, YouTube, Display, and Discovery.

facts.fact: The page's 7-step Google Ads strategy for moving companies is described as containing seven steps.
facts.quote: The 7-step Google Ads strategy will give you the basic building blocks for your Google Ads campaign.

facts.fact: The page advises that campaign goals should always be set to 'leads' so Google can optimise for customers booking services.
facts.quote: you want to ensure your campaign goals are always set to ‘leads’
